column1: # STRUCTURE DEBT REGISTER (this package's own) v1.0.0 -- the lines of pib-hub, and of no other package.
# The owner ruled on 2026-10-07 that a package carries its own register and clears its own lines in its own release, which is
# what BP-D54 always said; the governance aggregate carries the ceilings and the ecosystem-wide view.
# A line may be removed here, and a count lowered here, with nobody else involved: debt may always shrink. A count may NOT be
# raised here, a line the aggregate does not carry may NOT be added, and a status may NOT be raised to `exception`: the checker
# fails the run and the aggregate generator refuses it, keeping the previous ceiling. Those go through the owner's ruling,
# recorded in the aggregate line as `ruling: ...`.
# FIRST VERSION, adopted in PIB v2.19.0 -- and NOT the nine lines the handover offered, for a stated reason.
# The handover of 2026-10-07 offered nine lines, and the governance aggregate carries those same nine. Every one of them
# names a file of `Ontologies/pib-hub/` -- the RETIRED, FROZEN monorepo directory, whose own RETIRED_v1_0_0.md records that
# PIB moved to `altunelyusuf/PIB` on 2026-09-10 and that this repository is "the governed home and the only source of truth
# for PIB from v1.4.1 onward". Those nine lines are measurements of a tree PIB may not edit, at file versions this repository
# left behind (`profile_tbox_v1_0_0_1.ttl` against today's `profile_tbox_v1_2_0.ttl`, for instance).
# The eighteen lines below are the FIRST MEASUREMENT OF THE GOVERNED HOME, taken on 2026-10-22 with
# `oe_structure_check_v1_7_1.py <this repo> --as-package pib-hub` -- the `--as-package` view the handover itself prescribes
# for a package published from its own repository, without which every top-level folder resolves as a separate package and
# the counts are wrong (9 "packages", 23 violations; as one package, 18).
# This is NOT a count raised against the aggregate: it is a different tree, which the aggregate has never measured. The
# difference is reported to OE in `09-handover-inbox/accepted/RETURN_PIB_to_OE_structure-handovers-measured-on-the-frozen-copy_v1_0_0.md`,
# together with the one question the rules do not settle: whether the retired directory should be treated as retired history,
# which no session may clear while it is frozen.
